title: list marks blocked rows with !
lead: Text rows in `list`, `find` and `deps` mark an item that waits on an unfinished dependency with `!`, as the TUI queue already does, so the readiness order explains itself.
findings_note: owner session 2026-10-14: blocked rows in `slicer list` ranked below score-11 rows with nothing showing why
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a JSON field for blocked state, naming the blockers in the row (`deps ID` does that), and any change to ranking.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `list` ranks blocked items after every ready item (`graph.ranked_order`, called from `_list_in_priority_order` in `src/slicer/cli.py:1652`). The text row from `_item_rows` (`src/slicer/cli.py:1615`) has no blocked marker, though. On 2026-10-14, s274, s275, s283, s284 and s285 (score 22) listed below s272 and s281 (score 11), and nothing in the row said why. The TUI already puts `!` after the row number (`src/slicer/tui.py:255-259`), and `docs/tui.md` describes it. The CLI should match.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py`: in `_item_rows`, compute `graph.blocked_by(state.index, item, cfg.satisfying_statuses())` and write `{n:>3}!` instead of `{n:>3} ` when it is non-empty. That replaces one of the two spaces, so column widths stay the same. Update the docstring.
- `docs/commands.md` (the `list` row and the STATUS/column text near line 208), `CHANGELOG.md`.
- `tests/test_cli.py`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_List_Text_BlockedRow_MarkedWithBang`: A depends on open B. A's row has `!` after its number and B's row does not.
- `test_List_Text_DependencyDone_NoBang`: after B is done, A's row has no marker.
- `test_Find_Text_BlockedRow_MarkedWithBang`: the shared row format also marks it in `find`.
- `test_List_Json_Unchanged_ByBlockedMarker`: the JSON output has no new key.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Add the marker in `_item_rows`.
3. Run the existing exact-row tests (`tests/test_cli.py`, `tests/test_scoring.py`, `tests/test_worktree_claims.py`) and fix any expectation that had a blocked row.
4. Update the docs and CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.
- Running `slicer list` on this repo shows `!` on rows that wait on an open item.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s286`, branch `feature/s286-list-blocked-marker`. Commit only on the branch.
